content5.ptxt: If the resistance between 6 (CANH), 14 (CANL) and 16 (BAT) of DLC3 is below 6k Ω, the CAN bus may be shorted to +B.

atten4.ptxt: 2WD models equipped with neither pre-crash safety nor radar cruise control have no CAN gateway ECU wiring.

atten3.ptxt: When measuring the resistance of the CAN bus, turn the IG OFF, confirm that warning functions such as the key reminder warning system are not operating, and leave the vehicle for 1 minutes or more without operating the key or switches or opening/closing the doors before starting measurement. If it is necessary to open a door during inspection, open it beforehand.

atten4.ptxt: When disconnecting a connector, check that the connector terminals and connector case are free of damage, deformation, corrosion, etc.
